meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 当用户问起 senpi 的任何提示时，Claude 不再凭记忆回答，而是先获取实时提示列表，再读取该用户的设置与历史，判断此人实际可见的提示，然后阅读底层代码，用用户的语言给出深度解释并注明文件路径。
howto.when: 当用户问起某条 Tip: 提示、说“give-me-tips”或询问提示含义等时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 是什么意思？讲讲背后的实现。
say.note: Claude 会先查实时列表，再读代码解释。

say.text: give-me-tips，这个提示的机制是什么？
say.note: 会给出带文件路径的深入说明。

say.text: 为什么我这边看不到某些提示？
say.note: 会检查该用户的设置与历史。

howto.what_en: On any senpi tip question, Claude queries the live tip list, checks the user's settings/history for visible tips, then reads the code and explains in-depth in the user's language, citing file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about a Tip: line, says 'give-me-tips', or asks what a tip means, etc.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean? Explain the mechanism behind it.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the live list and reads the code first.

say_en.text: give-me-tips, how does this tip's mechanism work?
say_en.note: Gives an in-depth explanation with file paths.

say_en.text: Why can't I see some tips on my side?
say_en.note: Checks the user's settings and history.
